source.establishes: Reference standard and protective cap exist; internal cap fit dimensions are not supplied

current_geometry_issue: Current inferred cap bore radius 26.3 mm exceeds the 26 mm holder-body radius and has no internal stop, so a face-down reference could bottom on its optical face.

candidate_cap_inference.support: Cap rim supports the non-optical body shoulder; smaller nose enters the opening. This is an unverified mechanical reconstruction, not a manufacturer tolerance or a robot fixture.

candidate_sequence: Use the selected continuous left-hand reference lift at base [9.35,7.85], yaw 1.7.
Carry the reference through a 0.30 m lateral step to base [9.05,7.85], keeping it in front of the FTIR housing. This walk/contact state has not been planned.
Move first to the left of the Nicolet housing, then lower the reference face-down into its ordinary protective cap; support only through the non-optical shoulder.
Release and withdraw after seating; preserve reference identity and later reverse the procedure to restore it to the sphere port.
remaining: Build a versioned cap reconstruction with clear inferred dimensions and preserve the old geometry.
Check cap/reference support, optical-face clearance and full source-hand closure/release.
Plan the carrying step, table-side arm route and restoration; validate entire scene.
Add ordinary-tweezer specimen handling and correct reference/background/sample scan ordering.
